note: Recorded evidence (probe-tier facts) of assistant-platform integrations for Ultrametric vendors. No scores or verdicts. Sweep method: full roster (564 unique products across all arenas) matched by normalized name and site domain against each platform catalog; top-150-by-Overall-score entries were individually adjudicated, name-collision false positives excluded. urlStatus is the HTTP status curl observed for url on verifiedAt (403 = listing exists but the platform bot-blocks keyless fetches; 0 = keyless fetch failed/timed out).

platforms.name: ChatGPT (OpenAI)
platforms.mechanism: Plugin Directory (since 2026-07-09) bundling Apps SDK/MCP apps, connectors, and skills; apps discovery at chatgpt.com/apps
platforms.notes: chatgpt.com/plugins and per-app listing pages (chatgpt.com/apps/<slug>) return HTTP 403 to keyless fetches (verified 2026-09-28). Mechanism docs keylessly fetchable at https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/extend/mcp.md. Catalog swept via community mirror rdmgator12/awesome-chatgpt-apps (1,624 apps + 14 connectors, capture 2026-07-02).

platforms.name: Claude (Anthropic)
platforms.mechanism: Connectors (remote MCP servers) — curated web directory + in-app catalog incl. community and desktop-extension connectors; separate Claude Plugins catalog for Claude Code
platforms.notes: claude.com/directory redirects to claude.ai/directory which returns HTTP 403 to keyless fetches (verified 2026-09-28). Docs keylessly fetchable: https://claude.com/docs/connectors/directory and https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11176164. Catalog swept via community mirror rdmgator12/awesome-claude-connectors (3,044 connectors, capture 2026-09-25; markers: none=verified/partner tier, C=community, A=Anthropic-built).

platforms.name: Grok (xAI)
platforms.mechanism: Connectors (launched 2026-05-06): OAuth catalog tiles + admin-provisioned enterprise built-ins + Bring Your Own MCP; built-in document/spreadsheet Skills
platforms.notes: grok.com/connectors serves HTTP 200 keylessly but the catalog itself renders only in a logged-in session (static HTML lacks the tile list; verified 2026-09-28). Platform docs keylessly fetchable at https://docs.x.ai/grok/connectors (lists built-ins; confirms the catalog). Catalog swept via community mirror rdmgator12/awesome-grok-connectors (28 tiles + 3 enterprise built-ins, capture 2026-08-12).

platforms.name: Muse (Meta)
platforms.mechanism: Connectors: fixed Meta-built, Meta-reviewed directory (39 at 2026-09-08 launch, 56 after Connect 2026) + Muse-built custom connectors from any public API/CLI/MCP; developer submissions opened 2026-09-18 at muse.ai/platform
platforms.notes: muse.ai/connectors returns HTTP 401 to keyless fetches (verified 2026-09-28); the developer platform page muse.ai/platform is keylessly fetchable (HTTP 200). Directory swept via third-party mirror sprites.ai/muse/connectors (56 connectors, fetched 2026-09-28). No vendor-submitted third-party connectors were live in the directory at capture time.

sweep.boundary: Automated name+domain match over the full 564-product roster; manual adjudication of every hit and of top-150-by-Overall-score near-misses. Long-tail (<top-150) hits are included when the automated match was unambiguous.
